This massive overvaluation leaves TSLA highly vulnerable to downside risk. Additionally, there is no clear activism opportunity to unlock upside. Given these factors, TSLA does not align with Ackman’s principles of high-quality businesses, financial discipline, and prudent valuation. A bearish stance is justified with high confidence.
